note: Source registry for the 21 sport families OLBG lists (catalogue manually reviewed 2026-09-20, docs/OLBG-RESEARCH.md). This file records what the candidate sources' robots.txt and licences ACTUALLY say, with the fetched text, the fetch date and a link a human can open. It is not a coverage claim: the automation gate is computed from those facts (northstar/sources.py::gate_for) and only 'permitted_open_licence' (a licence already recorded and tested in northstar/policy.py) allows a collector to run.

method.robots: robots.txt fetched over HTTPS through the agent's read-only fetch tool on 2026-09-22; the quoted text is verbatim from that fetch. A 404 (no robots file served) is recorded as 'no_robots_file' and is NOT permission. Line endings are normalised to LF when the quote is rendered (the CR/LF characters are the source's own line endings; the text is otherwise verbatim).
method.licence: 'open_licence_verified' is only ever set when the source already appears in northstar/policy.py (the tested licensing registry) with a collection mode that permits it. Everything else is 'not_reviewed' and stays behind a licence gate - robots.txt is not a licence.
method.links: links with link_verified=true returned the expected page content when fetched on 2026-09-22. Unverified deep links are marked false and point at the domain root that was actually fetched.
method.strategy_designs: design-stage entries are pre-registered hypotheses with no graded result; an entry may only be marked graded/forward-live if it names a strategy id that exists in northstar/strategies/REGISTRY.py and is unit-tested.

strategy_designs.name: Market-favourite baseline (reference desk)
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Favourites in UK/IRE flat and jumps races are systematically underbet relative to longshots; the desk must first reproduce the documented favourite-longshot bias on this jurisdiction's data before any fade is tested.
strategy_designs.rule: Level-stake the margin-removed market favourite in every race of the selected jurisdiction; report strike rate, ROI and the longshot half of the same sample as the control.
strategy_designs.gate: Needs a permissioned race-result source (declared runners, going, dead heats) plus a licensed odds archive; dead heats and non-runners must be defined before the first bet.

strategy_designs.name: Place-probability calibration by field size
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Place probability is mis-modelled when field size and each-way terms are pooled; calibration by field size will show where the market's place prices drift.
strategy_designs.rule: Fit place probabilities separately for each field-size band and race type, then grade calibration (reliability curve) against official placings; no bet is placed until calibration beats the pooled model out of sample.
strategy_designs.gate: Same result-source gate as above, plus official each-way terms per race.

sports.next_action: Human decision on a licensed racing-results/odds provider (e.g. an official race-data licence); nothing may be collected from the regulator's site without a licence review.

strategy_designs.name: Market favourite (baseline)
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Bookmaker favourites are the least-losing naive strategy on the verified pilot.
strategy_designs.rule: Level-stake the market-average favourite every match.
strategy_designs.gate: passed (football-data.co.uk manual pilot import + OpenLigaDB ODbL results)

strategy_designs.name: Elo value edge
strategy_designs.hypothesis: A plain Elo rating finds value against the margin-removed market average.
strategy_designs.rule: Elo K=40, home advantage 60, 3-way logistic; bet only with a >= 3-point model edge.
strategy_designs.gate: passed

strategy_designs.name: Dixon-Coles 1X2 value
strategy_designs.hypothesis: The Dixon-Coles low-score correction finds 1X2 value the independent Poisson misses.
strategy_designs.rule: Bivariate score matrix with the tau correction (rho=-0.10 pre-registered); bet the argmax with a >= 3-point edge.
strategy_designs.gate: passed

strategy_designs.name: Poisson totals value (O/U 2.5)
strategy_designs.hypothesis: A league-rate Poisson goal model finds value in the over/under 2.5 price.
strategy_designs.rule: League rates + shrunk attack/defence multipliers from released matches; bet a >= 3-point edge.
strategy_designs.gate: passed

strategy_designs.name: Poisson Asian-handicap value
strategy_designs.hypothesis: The Poisson goal model finds value on the priced Asian handicap line.
strategy_designs.rule: Same Poisson model evaluated on the stored AH line; quarter lines split the stake; positive EV and a >= 3% edge required.
strategy_designs.gate: passed

strategy_designs.name: Football Elo favourite (forward desk)
strategy_designs.hypothesis: No-market Elo picks beat the home baseline on the current season's results.
strategy_designs.rule: 3-way Elo argmax with a 45% selectivity floor; frozen pre-start in the append-only forward ledger.
strategy_designs.gate: results-only (OpenLigaDB 2026/27 captures); no permissioned odds path, so accuracy/Brier only

strategy_designs.name: Market longshot (baseline probe)
strategy_designs.hypothesis: If the documented favourite-longshot bias is present, backing the longest shot should lose heavily - a direction check on the pilot data, not a strategy.
strategy_designs.rule: Level-stake the longest-priced outcome in every match.
strategy_designs.gate: passed (baseline probe)

strategy_designs.name: Recency-decay Elo control
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Older matches carry less information; ratings that relax toward the 1500 seed on a 365-day half-life improve on plain Elo.
strategy_designs.rule: Identical to elo-edge-v1 with R_eff(t) = 1500 + (R-1500)*2^(-dt/365d).
strategy_designs.gate: passed (control desk)

strategy_designs.name: Draw mispricing probe
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Draws are systematically over-priced as longshots in some samples (returning value when the model's draw probability exceeds the fair price).
strategy_designs.rule: Bet DRAW when model draw probability minus margin-removed price >= 3 points.
strategy_designs.gate: passed

strategy_designs.name: Home-advantage value probe
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Home advantage is mispriced when crowd effects change (ghost games), in either direction.
strategy_designs.rule: Bet HOME only with a >= 5-point model edge over the fair price.
strategy_designs.gate: passed

strategy_designs.name: Form + price floor
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Recent-form information is undervalued by odds (tipster rule, made auditable).
strategy_designs.rule: Back the better recent-form side (>= 1.0 pts/match gap over last 3 released matches) only at price >= 1.80.
strategy_designs.gate: passed

strategy_designs.name: Draw-No-Bet decisive form
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Removing the draw from a 3-way price is a testable construction, not automatically an edge.
strategy_designs.rule: Elo edge on the 2-way DNB projection, decisive matches only.
strategy_designs.gate: passed

strategy_designs.name: Market totals favourite (baseline)
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Reference desk for the O/U 2.5 market: does the market's own favourite beat a goal model?
strategy_designs.rule: Always back the margin-removed market favourite side of the 2.5 line.
strategy_designs.gate: passed (baseline)

strategy_designs.name: Market AH favourite (baseline)
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Reference desk for the Asian-handicap market.
strategy_designs.rule: Always back the margin-removed market favourite side of the priced AH line (quarter lines split the stake).
strategy_designs.gate: passed (baseline)

strategy_designs.name: Always-home season baseline
strategy_designs.hypothesis: The full-season no-market desks must beat 'always home' on the same 306 matches or their hit rate is not information.
strategy_designs.rule: Always predict the home side; flat 0.50/0.25/0.25 prior stated before grading (never fitted).
strategy_designs.gate: passed (baseline, added 2026-09-22)

strategy_designs.name: Poisson totals season desk
strategy_designs.hypothesis: The independent-Poisson totals model's 2.5-line argmax beats the always-over baseline over a whole committed season.
strategy_designs.rule: Same Poisson construction as the pilot totals desk with no price input; states the more likely side of 2.5 for every match.
strategy_designs.gate: passed (added 2026-09-22); no odds path, accuracy/Brier only

strategy_designs.name: Always-over 2.5 season baseline
strategy_designs.hypothesis: The share of over-2.5 matches in the pool is the bar the totals model must clear; if it does not, the model has shown no information.
strategy_designs.rule: Always predict OVER 2.5; flat 0.5/0.5 prior (Brier 0.5 by construction).
strategy_designs.gate: passed (baseline, added 2026-09-22)

sports.next_action: Keep the forward desks running; add a second independent result source for the current season and a licensed odds path before any 2026/27 PnL exists.

strategy_designs.rule: K=32, home advantage 35 Elo pts, floor 0.55.
strategy_designs.gate: passed (ODbL results); no odds path

strategy_designs.name: Home-ice naive baseline
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Home ice is worth about 54.5% of regular-season wins (reference bar for every hockey desk).
strategy_designs.rule: Always home, flat 0.5/0.5 prior.
strategy_designs.gate: passed (baseline)

strategy_designs.name: Poisson regulation 3-way
strategy_designs.hypothesis: An independent-Poisson goal model adds information about the 60-minute 3-way outcome.
strategy_designs.rule: League rates + shrunk multipliers; argmax of the regulation 3-way.
strategy_designs.gate: passed

strategy_designs.name: Margin-of-victory Elo
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Scaling the Elo update by the goal margin beats the plain W/L update (added 2026-09-22).
strategy_designs.rule: K x g with the World-Football-Elo margin weights; same ratings pool as the plain desk.
strategy_designs.gate: passed

strategy_designs.name: Poisson totals O/U 5.5
strategy_designs.hypothesis: The Maher/Dixon-Coles Poisson totals model transfers to DEL total goals over/under 5.5 (second prediction-only market, added 2026-09-22).
strategy_designs.rule: P(total >= 6) from the same league-rate/attack/defence construction; states the more likely side for every match.
strategy_designs.gate: passed

strategy_designs.name: Always-over baseline
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Reference point for the totals desk: the share of DEL games over 5.5 goals.
strategy_designs.rule: Always over, flat 0.5/0.5 prior.
strategy_designs.gate: passed (baseline)

strategy_designs.name: Regulation home naive baseline
strategy_designs.hypothesis: Reference bar for the regulation 3-way desks: the share of 60-minute home wins.
strategy_designs.rule: Always home in regulation, flat 0.5/0/0.5 prior.
strategy_designs.gate: passed (baseline)
